name: Toy Town
author: ZepherGD
description: Go above the ball portal between the monster and saw as the wave at 30%. Navigate through the following gameplay as the wave until 40% where you can fall to the floor (and stay there) shortly before the cube and gravity portal. Move up to the ceiling at 74% and then spam in the middle of the gameplay until you reach the ship portal at 79%. Play the rest of the level normally from there.
